course.title: Learn Stock Trading — From Zero to Confident
course.subtitle: A complete, beginner-friendly course on reading the market, analysing companies, entering trades, making profit and handling loss.
course.author: Trading Docs
course.disclaimer: Educational content only. This is NOT financial advice. Trading and investing carry a real risk of losing money. Always do your own research and never risk money you cannot afford to lose.

format.app_note: Each chapter is a self-contained Markdown file. Parse the YAML frontmatter for metadata (title, order, tags, quiz) and render the body. Use this manifest to build the module/chapter navigation tree.

modules.title: Trading Foundations
modules.goal: Understand what the market is, how it works, and how to place your first trade safely.

chapters.title: What Is the Stock Market?
chapters.summary: A simple picture of what a stock market is and why it exists.

chapters.title: How Stocks Work
chapters.summary: What a share really is: owning a slice of a company, and how you make money from it.

chapters.title: Who's Who: Participants & Exchanges
chapters.summary: The players in the market — exchanges, brokers, regulators, retail and institutions.

chapters.title: What You Can Trade
chapters.summary: Stocks, ETFs, indices, futures and options — what each one is, in plain words.

chapters.title: Trading vs Investing
chapters.summary: Two different games with different timeframes, tools and mindsets — and which one fits you.

chapters.title: Accounts, Brokers & Getting Started
chapters.summary: Demat & trading accounts, choosing a broker, and the steps to go live.

chapters.title: Order Types Explained
chapters.summary: Market, limit, stop-loss and other orders — the exact buttons you'll press.

chapters.title: Market Hours & the Order Book
chapters.summary: When markets open, how the order book works, and what bid/ask and spread mean.

modules.title: Reading Charts & Price Action

chapters.title: How Price Moves
chapters.summary: Price moves in waves — impulse and pullback — creating higher highs or lower lows.

chapters.title: Anatomy of a Candlestick

chapters.title: Single Candlestick Patterns
chapters.summary: Doji, hammer, shooting star, marubozu — one candle, one message.

chapters.title: Multi-Candle Patterns
chapters.summary: Engulfing, harami, morning/evening star — how groups of candles signal reversals.

chapters.title: Chart Types & Timeframes
chapters.summary: Line vs bar vs candle, and how to pick and combine timeframes.
